en-US.whatsNew:
Widgets now stay on the album you picked, even after days without opening Frame.

• Fixed a widget switching to a different album until Frame was opened
• Fixed a widget asking you to pick an album it already had
• If a widget cannot read your library for a moment, it tries again within 15 minutes instead of showing other photos
en-US.promotionalText: Free forever. No ads, no subscriptions, no paywall, no limits. Unlimited albums, a different album on every widget, and photos that change on their own all day.
